title: Saudi Aramco Q2 profit jumps on stronger oil prices
summary: Aramco has maintained its quarterly dividend at $21.9 billion

contentHtml:
FILE PHOTO: The Saudi Aramco logo is pictured in Paris, France, February 1, 2024. REUTERS/Benoit Tessier.

Aramco has maintained its quarterly dividend at $21.9 billion

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Saudi Aramco reported a 42% jump in Q2 2026 net profit, boosted by higher oil and product prices that partly offset rising operating costs and taxes.
